query: My MacBook has 18 GB free and ~/Library/Developer is enormous. Audit Xcode storage, rank cleanup candidates by GB, and wait for me before deleting anything.
Can you check whether DerivedData for branches and worktrees I deleted is still taking space? I have three xcodebuild jobs running, so inspection only.
I think iOS 25 simulator devices are stranded after I removed the runtime. Show unavailable devices and their sizes, but preserve current iOS 26 devices.
Downloads probably contains old Xcode_26.3.xip and DMGs. Match them against /Applications and tell me which installers can go.
I have Xcode.app, Xcode-26.4.app, and Xcode-beta.app. Is there evidence one is unused and safe to remove without breaking CI toolchains?
Why is CoreSimulator using 60GB? Audit devices versus runtimes, including the SwiftUI previews set, and suggest supported cleanup actions.
Need disk space before installing macOS. Review Xcode archives, dSYMs, DeviceSupport, SwiftPM caches and local .build folders under ~/Developer.
xcode storage cleanup please — measure what I can recover, explain rebuild/download costs, and only trash the exact items I approve
Our build agents accumulate SDK caches and stale package artifacts. Create a read-only Xcode disk report suitable for deciding a cleanup policy.
I approved candidate IDs derived-missing:OldApp and xcode-installer:Xcode_26.3.xip:123 from the audit you just showed. Move only those to Trash and verify.
Xcode says the build database is locked and two compile commands are still running. Diagnose the build failure without deleting DerivedData.
The iOS Simulator crashes when launching my app. Inspect the crash logs and help fix the app code.
Please optimize our Xcode clean-build duration and find Swift type-checking hotspots. Disk space is fine.
Create a GitHub Actions workflow that caches DerivedData and Swift packages between CI runs.
My production crash report is unsymbolicated. Find the matching dSYM in our Xcode archives and symbolicate it.
Install Xcode 26.4 from the downloaded XIP, select it with xcode-select, and accept the license.
Write a Swift script using FileManager to compute folder sizes and print them as JSON.
I need an App Store archive for version 4.2 and want to upload it through Organizer.
Reset the content and settings of the currently booted iPhone simulator because onboarding state is broken.
Our Swift package cannot resolve dependencies after an Xcode update. Diagnose registry authentication and Package.resolved conflicts.
